# AgenticGraph

## Source Files

- Editor Workspace Source Files for LLMs: /api/storage/llms.txt
- Editor Workspace Source Files index: /api/storage/source-files
- Live Canvas Hero discovery markdown: /agenticgraph-live-canvas-hero.md
- Default published Source File markdown documents: /api/storage/doc-default/{canonicalPath}
- Source File markdown documents: /api/storage/doc/{workspaceId}/{canonicalPath}
- Canonical shared default document URLs: /agenticgraph/share/{opaque-default-doc-token}
- Canonical shared document URLs: /agenticgraph/share/{opaque-doc-token}
- Query-param aliases: /agenticgraph/?kgShare={opaque-doc-token}, /agenticgraph/?kgCanonicalPath={canonicalPath}, /agenticgraph/?kgWorkspaceId={workspaceId}&kgCanonicalPath={canonicalPath}
- Shared document path aliases: /agenticgraph/doc-default/{canonicalPath}, /agenticgraph/doc/{workspaceId}/{canonicalPath}

## Access Policy

- Cloudflare AI Crawl Control Pay Per Crawl can apply at the zone boundary.
- If enabled, unpaid AI crawler requests can receive HTTP 402 with crawler-price.
- Successful paid crawler access can receive HTTP 200 with crawler-charged.
- The storage routes remain read-only and do not emulate payment headers or prices.

## App

- AgenticGraph workspace: /agenticgraph/
- Agent-ready health: /agenticgraph/health
- Agent-ready MCP transport: /agenticgraph/mcp
- Agent-ready OpenAPI: /agenticgraph/.well-known/openapi.json
- A2A Agent Card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
